questions.stem: A 28-year-old G2P1 woman with known Rh-negative blood group presents at 32 weeks for routine follow-up. Her first pregnancy was delivered at home, and she did not receive anti-D immunoglobulin postpartum. Current ultrasound shows signs of fetal hydrops: ascites, scalp edema, and placentomegaly. MCA-PSV is 1.7 MoM. What is the next best step in management?

options.label: A
options.text: Administer corticosteroids and await spontaneous labor

options.label: C
options.text: Perform intrauterine transfusion under ultrasound guidance
